local-outlier-factorcurated\begin{aligned} \term{kDistance}{d_k(j)}&=\max_{o\in N(j)}d(j,o),\qquad \term{reach}{\mathrm{reach}(i,j)}=\max\bigl(d_k(j),\ d(i,j)\bigr)\\ \term{density}{\mathrm{lrd}(i)}&=\frac{1}{\overline{\mathrm{reach}}(i)+\term{densityFloor}{\epsilon}}\\ \term{lof}{\mathrm{LOF}(i)}&=\frac{\overline{\mathrm{lrd}}\bigl(N(i)\bigr)}{\mathrm{lrd}(i)} \end{aligned}Over the kNN table: k-distance d_k(j) = largest neighbour distance of row j; reach(i, j) = max(d_k(j), d(i, j)); local reachability density lrd(i) = 1 / (mean over neighbours j of reach(i, j) + densityFloor); LOF(i) = mean over neighbours j of lrd(j) / lrd(i). A row with no neighbours gets density 0 and LOF 1. Scores near 1 are as dense as their neighbours; well above 1 is locally sparse. There is no null distribution, so the outlier mask uses a threshold the caller chooses.{"id":"kDistance","role":"intermediate","binding":"wgsl:kDistance"}, {"id":"reach","role":"intermediate","binding":"wgsl:distances"}, {"id":"density","role":"intermediate","binding":"wgsl:density"}, {"id":"densityFloor","role":"parameter","binding":"wgsl:parameters"}, {"id":"lof","role":"output","binding":"wgsl:lof"}

formula.ascii: Over the kNN table: k-distance d_k(j) = largest neighbour distance of row j; reach(i, j) = max(d_k(j), d(i, j)); local reachability density lrd(i) = 1 / (mean over neighbours j of reach(i, j) + densityFloor); LOF(i) = mean over neighbours j of lrd(j) / lrd(i). A row with no neighbours gets density 0 and LOF 1. Scores near 1 are as dense as their neighbours; well above 1 is locally sparse. There is no null distribution, so the outlier mask uses a threshold the caller chooses.
